name: Ghost Drone (SITL)
description: Simulated ArduPilot motorboat running in SITL. Development and testing only; not a real platform. Identity and dimensions match the sim-drone-01 entry in Crowsnest's platform registry.

complex_max.description: Hull envelope for the 4.0 x 1.5 m motorboat, relative to the CCRP amidships

frame_transforms.sensor_description: Simulated GNSS. SITL models no antenna lever arm, so this is co-located with the body origin: the published location_fix IS the body origin, not an offset antenna.
Simulated IMU, co-located with the body origin. Attitude and rate subjects are reported in the body frame with no mounting offset.
